reference_policy: References used for composition, pose, environment, and light direction only. Fur and surfaces re-rendered from scratch.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: vertical night wildlife photograph, source render for a 1080 × 1920 final crop
Primary request: Create a genuinely photographic re-render of a melanistic leopard on a red sandstone ledge in a desert canyon at night. Use reference Image 1 only for the animal's crouching pose, right-facing profile composition, sandstone environment, and side-light direction. Re-render the animal's fur and all surfaces from scratch; do not reproduce, transfer, or imitate the reference image's fur texture.
Scene/backdrop: red sandstone ledge in a desert canyon at night; only a little fine dust drifting naturally through the torch beam; distant canyon walls dissolve into creamy bokeh.
Subject: one melanistic leopard, near-black fur, rosettes only faintly visible where grazing light catches them. Fur must read as a soft dense mass, uneven, slightly matted and subtly clumped where damp, with most of it lost in near-black shadow. The eye is the sharpest point in the frame. Ear, shoulder, back, paws, and rear body fall progressively and softly out of focus. The torch catches only a thin restrained rim on the edge of the head and back. Specular highlights only on the eye, wet nose, and a few whiskers.
Style/medium: authentic real night wildlife photograph shot on a full-frame mirrorless camera with a 400mm f/2.8 lens wide open, ISO 6400, 1/250 s; one hand-held torch from the side; visible fine sensor grain; gentle photographic processing.
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3 at 1024 × 1536; animal fully contained inside the central 80% so a later center crop to 9:16 keeps it intact; low ledge foreground, right-facing profile, eye near the upper-middle; shallow depth of field and creamy bokeh.
Lighting/mood: a single hand-held side torch, restrained and natural, deep night shadows, no fill light.
Color palette: restrained natural colour; near-black animal, muted red sandstone, small warm torch accents.
Constraints: look unmistakably like a real high-ISO wildlife photograph; maintain pose/composition/light direction from Image 1 only; no HUD, no text, no watermark.
Avoid: glossy separate strands; every hair highlighted; droplets on every whisker; uniform wetness; HDR; over-sharpening; high local contrast across the frame; bronze or brown fur; strong obvious rosettes; illustration; painting; CGI; 3D-render look; excessive dust or sparks; anatomy errors.
